titulo: Vitachy White and Gold Ceramic Soap Dispenser 350ml - Pure Soap Bath
bullets: VINTAGE ELEGANCE: White glazed ceramic dispenser with pump in MATT GOLDEN. Its design emulates an artisan soap bar with the inscription "Pure Soap" embossed, bringing a chic and Mediterranean touch to your bathroom or kitchen.

ANTI-RUST MATT GOLD ABS PUMP: The pump is made of high strength ABS with matte gold finish (not metal). This is precisely why it does not rust or itch with soap and water and retains its warm tone with daily use. Doses 2ml per pulsation, no drips.

RECHARGEABLE AUTHENTIC ENAMEL CERAMIC: The body is made of real glazed ceramic: heavy, stable and easy to clean, keeps its shine like the first day. Fill it as often as you want and reduce the consumption of single-use packaging.

350 ml for hands, kitchen and bathroom: With a 350 ml tank, it is perfect as a hand soap dispenser, liquid dishwasher or body lotion. Its wide base provides superior stability and allows for one-handed use, even for children.
PROTECTIVE PACKAGING: The product is delivered in a rigid cardboard box and bubble wrapped, so that the ceramic piece arrives at your home in perfect condition.
descripcion_html: Elevate the elegance of your bathroom with this VITACHY soap dispenser, a piece that combines functionality and style. Crafted from white glazed ceramic with a smooth and refined finish, it features a minimalist design with the words 'PURE SOAP' engraved in relief. The gold dispenser adds a touch of sophistication and luxury to the ensemble. With a generous capacity of 350ml, it is perfect for liquid hand soap. Its gold-tone chrome metering pump ensures precise and drip-free dispensing. The dispenser's dimensions make it ideal for any bathroom or kitchen space, while its stable base prevents accidental slipping. The combination of ceramic white with gold accents makes it a versatile complement that harmonizes with any decorative style, from the most classic to the contemporary.
